newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Russia offers to help Nigeria diamond mining.
newsitem.headline: Russia offers to help Nigeria diamond mining.

text.p: A Russian official said on Wednesday Moscow would assist Nigeria in the geographical mapping of its mining sector through the use of space technology as well as in developing its diamond deposits.

Vladimir Artemiev, a Russian embassy trade official, was quoted by the state news agency as telling solid minerals minister Kaloma Ali in the capital Abuja that the space technology would make it easier for Nigeria to assess geological formation of minerals in the country.
Ali said that the proposals would be studied and a reply would be given after four weeks.
"Russia, we know, has the advanced technology for prospecting diamonds. We have to ask you to cooperate with us and look for diamonds and other precious stones," he said.
The military government has since 1995 turned attention to solid minerals, which it said Nigeria has in abundance, to diversify the country's foreign exchange earning sources.
According to finance minister Anthony Ani, Nigeria hoped to earn about 161 billion naira of its projected 404 billion naira this year from non-oil sources, including solid minerals.
